Saquon Barkley (hamstring) was upgraded to a full practice Saturday and is questionable for Monday night against Dallas. Shootyeah needs a backup plan locked in before Sunday's games start.
Breece Hall (quad) is questionable and could return, likely sharing work with Braelon Allen. McCallyCockin(his butt) also has DJ Moore out.

Tyler Warren, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery and Rashee Rice are all officially out. That's four Skatabooboo players before ClaytonBigsbi even sets a lineup.
Brian Robinson Jr. and Zach Charbonnet are out and Rico Dowdle is questionable. GeorigaGoocher's running back room behind Jonathan Taylor is thin again for NailinMaye’sPurdyJohnson.

stories.title: Sunday viewing guide: no Lamar, maybe no Puka, and Baker says he's good
stories.dek: The 5‑1 first-place team lost its namesake for the day. It doesn't matter. Here's what does in Week 7.
body: Lamar Jackson got downgraded to out on Saturday and Tyler Huntley starts for Baltimore. DuvalTiliFall shrugged, because Patrick Mahomes has been LetLamarCook's quarterback for weeks and Mahomes has no injury designation. LetLamarCook is 5-1 and an 11.5-point favorite over BrentMayfieldsomepain.

On the other side of that game, Baker Mayfield is questionable with a thumb injury, but his coach says he's ready. tballsmccall has Mayfield, the guy in his team name, and Bo Nix, who has 69.66 points all season. If he starts Nix with Mayfield active, this website will be discussing it Tuesday.

The game of the week is I Pulled My McCaff (-19.5) against PickensMyPukaHurts!, and Puka Nacua is likely a game-time decision. ChuckJ10 has the best all-time record in the league (23-11) and still gets the late-game coin flip on the player his team is named after. Hing1eMcCring13berry has won three straight and doesn't care either way.

The commissioner's McCallyCockin(his butt) is an 11.5-point favorite over Your Mom’s Magic Dick. Breece Hall is questionable and could return. Emeka Egbuka is out for Cavemanfsu. Allen-tents & Purposes gets Jonah Coleman back against In It for Da Penix, and Saquon Barkley went full on Saturday for a Monday night game. Shootyeah, set the backup before 1 PM.

stories.title: Week 7 pays the closest win. This league is very good at close games.
stories.dek: By a C-Hair goes to the winning team with the smallest margin of victory. The history says somebody's getting paid for a nail-biter.
body: The Week 7 side pot is By a C-Hair: the winning team with the smallest margin of victory takes the money. Blowouts get you nothing this week.

This season has already had some tight ones. Allen-tents & Purposes beat LetLamarCook 140.36 to 140.04 in Week 3, a 0.32-point margin. Your Mom’s Magic Dick beat In It for Da Penix by 1.04 in Week 5. Skatabooboo lost by 3.86 in Week 1, and The Brown & Bijan Shough lost to I Pulled My McCaff by 4.56 in Week 2.

The Sportsbook's tightest Week 7 lines are both 11.5: LetLamarCook over BrentMayfieldsomepain and McCallyCockin(his butt) over Your Mom’s Magic Dick. If the commissioner squeaks one out, the commissioner gets paid by the league he runs. Nobody is surprised.
The biggest line is Allen-tents & Purposes at -46.5 over In It for Da Penix. RedDevil904 is not winning this payout. He'll live.

stories.title: LetLamarCook is 5‑1, and Lamar has had almost nothing to do with it
stories.dek: DuvalTiliFall went 6‑8 last year and set the league's all-time low. Now he's in first place with his namesake on the injury report.
body: Last season DuvalTiliFall went 6-8 and scored 60.44 in Week 11, still the lowest score in Is This Just Fantasy history. Six weeks into this one, LetLamarCook is 5-1 and in first place.
The only loss came in Week 3: 140.36 to 140.04 against Allen-tents & Purposes. That's 0.32 points from 6-0. Since then it's three straight wins, including a 167.70 in Week 5.

And it's not Lamar. Lamar Jackson was ruled out again Saturday, and Patrick Mahomes has been the starter. James Cook III (113.6 points), Kyren Williams (119) and Isaiah Likely (109.3) are doing the work. Mike Evans is also out this week.
The all-play says 43-23, fifth in the league, so some of this is the schedule. But first is first. Week 7 is BrentMayfieldsomepain, and the Sportsbook has LetLamarCook as an 11.5-point favorite.

stories.title: The 2024 champ is 1‑5. The 2025 champ can't pick a wide receiver.
stories.dek: Shootyeah and YourMomsDildo have the last two titles. Neither is having fun.
body: Shootyeah won the 2024 title and went 10-4 last year. In It for Da Penix is 1-5 with a 17-49 all-play, second-worst in the league. In Week 6 he left Tre Tucker's 27.7 on the bench and still won, his first win of the year. Then he paid $21 for Michael Penix Jr. and dropped Justin Herbert. It's on brand, at least.

YourMomsDildo is the defending champion. The Brown & Bijan Shough is 3-3 with 761.50 points, third in the league, so the roster is fine. The decisions are another story. In Week 6 he benched Tyler Shough (26.96), whose name is in the team name, and started Bryce Young (19.84). He lost by 24.64.
Then there's DeMario Douglas: $3 on Oct. 14, dropped Oct. 18 for Darren Waller, picked back up for $38 on Oct. 21, with Waller dropped the same day. That's $41 and a week of everyone's time.
Both get winnable games in Week 7. The Brown & Bijan Shough is favored by 14.5 over NailinMaye’sPurdyJohnson. In It for Da Penix is a 46.5-point dog against Allen-tents & Purposes. Good luck, champ.

feature.title: Week 6: I Pulled My McCaff cooks the co-commish, and LetLamarCook keeps rolling
body: I Pulled My McCaff had the top score of the week, 171.84, and beat Allen-tents & Purposes by 48.24. Christian McCaffrey had 30.7, Malik Nabers had 28.5, and Kenneth Walker III had 27.9. Hing1eMcCring13berry has won three straight and is tied for the best all-play in the league.

LetLamarCook beat The Brown & Bijan Shough 119.48 to 94.84. James Cook III had 24.3 and Isaiah Likely had 23.9. On the other side, YourMomsDildo started Bryce Young over Tyler Shough and left 26.96 on the bench.

McCallyCockin(his butt) beat NailinMaye’sPurdyJohnson 132.80 to 83.36. Drake Maye had 24.8 and Bhayshul Tuten had 24.7. GeorigaGoocher started Juwan Johnson at tight end (zero) and left Kirk Cousins's 19.52 on the bench while Brock Purdy scored 17.36.
In It for Da Penix got its first win, 102.06 to 82.84 over Skatabooboo, with Tre Tucker's 27.7 on the bench. Skatabooboo is still looking for its first.

ChuckJ10's tight end is Kyle Pitts Sr. GeorigaGoocher's running backs behind Jonathan Taylor are mostly on the injury report. Judkins has 56.3 points and fits right in.
DuvalTiliFall is without Mike Evans and has three good running backs. Marco_Polo's second running back is Rhamondre Stevenson (3.6 in Week 6).
ClaytonBigsbi sends away the one player who scores points on his team for a backup running back with 7 points this season. Do not do this.
YourMomsDildo has paid for DeMario Douglas twice. This would be the natural next step: trade the best player on the roster for a receiver with 4 points.
The commissioner trades his best receiver (104.2 points) for one with 1.7. This is what collusion looks like when it's also stupid.

columns.title: CHUCKJ10 HAS THE BEST RECORD IN LEAGUE HISTORY AND HE'S A 19.5‑POINT DOG? ARE YOU KIDDING ME?
columns.dek: PickensMyPukaHurts! is 4‑2. The man is 23‑11 all time. SHOW SOME RESPECT.
body: TWENTY-THREE AND ELEVEN! That's ChuckJ10's all-time regular-season record. Best in Is This Just Fantasy history! Nobody else has more than 21 wins! And the Sportsbook has PickensMyPukaHurts! as a 19.5-POINT DOG?!
He went 11-3 LAST YEAR! Finished third! He's 4-2 RIGHT NOW with a 41-25 all-play! Derrick Henry has 116.8 points! Zay Flowers! Dak Prescott! That's a REAL TEAM!

Yes, I Pulled My McCaff has won three straight. Yes, it put up 171.84 last week. Yes, Hing1eMcCring13berry has the deepest backfield in the league. I DON'T CARE! You don't spot the winningest manager in league history three touchdowns!
Puka Nacua is a game-time call. FINE! ChuckJ10 has been making late calls since 2024 and he's got the record to prove it! Take the points! TAKE THE POINTS!

columns.title: YourMomsDildo, pick a lineup and live with it
columns.dek: The defending champ has a playoff roster and keeps getting in his own way.
body: I watched the tape on The Brown & Bijan Shough. Bijan Robinson. Christian Watson. Javonte Williams. Tetairoa McMillan. Third in points, 39-27 all-play. That's a good football team.
Then Week 6. You bench Tyler Shough, who scored 26.96, and you start Bryce Young, who scored 19.84. You lose by 24.64. You don't get to put a man's name on your team and leave him on the bench.
Then the waiver wire. DeMario Douglas for $3. Drop him. Darren Waller. Drop him. DeMario Douglas again for $38. That's not managing, that's pacing.
You're the champ. Act like it. Set the lineup on Wednesday and stop touching it.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's Week 7 lineup checklist (do every one of these)
columns.dek: The payout this week goes to the smallest winning margin. I have a plan. It is not a good plan.
body: 1. Win by exactly 0.01. The Week 7 payout goes to the winning team with the smallest margin of victory. LetLamarCook lost by 0.32 in Week 3 and got nothing for it. Losing by a little doesn't pay. Winning by a little does. Simply score 0.01 more than your opponent. I don't see what's hard about this.
2. Bill_Buttlicker, start C.J. Stroud and Drake Maye at the same time. It's a one-QB league, and the app will try to stop you. Do not let an app tell you how to live.

3. YourMomsDildo, start Bryce Young again. Yes, Tyler Shough scored 26.96 on the bench in Week 6 while Young scored 19.84 and you lost by 24.64. But you can't lose by 24.64 twice in a row. That's just math.
4. ClaytonBigsbi, Skatabooboo is a 28.5-point dog. A bigger number is a better number. You're basically favored.

5. Set your lineup Tuesday and never look at it again. If anything changes on Sunday morning, that's Sunday's problem, and you won't be there to see it. This is how I finished 14th in a 12-team league.

columns.title: The co-commissioners, by the numbers: one is good, one is lucky
columns.dek: Allen-tents & Purposes and McCallyCockin(his butt) are both 4‑2. The math disagrees.
body: Both co-commissioners are 4-2. That's where the similarities end. Allen-tents & Purposes has 885.56 points and a 51-15 all-play. McCallyCockin(his butt) has 712.62 points and a 30-36 all-play.

Expected wins come from all-play: win percentage times games played. RedDevil904's 51-15 works out to 4.6 expected wins. Bill_Buttlicker's 30-36 works out to 2.7. One has been unlucky by about half a win. The other has been lucky by about 1.3.
Points against seals it. McCallyCockin(his butt) has allowed 635.10, second-fewest in the league. Allen-tents & Purposes has allowed 725.92.
My model says RedDevil904 wins more games from here. It also says Bill_Buttlicker approves this website's content, so this column may not run. If you're reading it, he didn't check.

exits.t: His name is in the team name. He scored 26.96 on the bench in Week 6 while YourMomsDildo started Bryce Young. He'd like a word.

Bought for $3, dropped four days later, then bought back for $38. Requesting a team that only signs him once.
Scored 19 on the bench in Week 6 while Denzel Boston (2.5) and MarShawn Lloyd (1) started. Wants out of a locker room that doesn't check scores.
Scored 19.52 on the bench while Brock Purdy put up 17.36. Doesn't expect to start, but would like it noted.
